title: D**g Dealer Gets Caught Red-Handed In a Publix Parking Lot
description:
#news #crime #police

Multiple officers had been conducting an investigation on a suspected drug dealer in town, they observed her pick up a stash full of cash, while she dropped off drugs and they quickly surrounded her as she tried to leave the scene. According to reports, she had called and convinced her friend to take her to the hospital because she was sick but had told him to make a stop at Publix because she wanted to throw up, unknowing to him, she wanted to drop of the drugs and that’s when police arrested her and him. The man explained to police that he had no involvement in this and did not know she had come to the location for a drug deal but due to his car being there, he was arrested as well. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
